# forma — Full Documentation

> Complete architecture, configuration specifications, and technical reference for forma, an interactive 3D product configurator.

---

# Overview

forma is a real-time 3D product configurator web application. It delivers a luxury studio experience for exploring and personalizing mechanical and industrial designs, including smartwatches, downhill mountain bikes, electric guitars, and mechanical keyboards.

- **Production URL**: https://forma-config.vercel.app
- **Interactive Studio**: https://forma-config.vercel.app/configurator

---

# Architecture & Tech Stack

- **Framework**: Next.js 16 (React 19, App Router with Turbopack)
- **3D Graphics**: Three.js (`three`) and React Three Fiber (`@react-three/fiber`)
- **3D Ecosystem**: `@react-three/drei` (OrbitControls, PerspectiveCamera, Environment, Html markers)
- **State Management**: Zustand (`zustand`)
- **Animation**: GSAP (`gsap`), Motion (`motion`), and Three.js Vector3/Spherical lerping
- **Styling**: Tailwind CSS v4 with dark mode and CSS design tokens
- **Authentication**: Clerk (`@clerk/nextjs`)
- **Database**: Neon Serverless Postgres with Drizzle ORM

---

# Core Features

## 1. 3D Model Visualization
High-fidelity PBR rendering with HDR lighting environments, dynamic soft contact shadows, and reflector floor materials:
- **Apple Watch Ultra 2**: Multi-component smartwatch with titanium chassis, digital crown, display face, alpine band, and biometric sensor backplate.
- **Santa Cruz V10**: Downhill mountain bike with carbon frame, Fox suspension, chainwheel, pedals, and disc brakes.
- **Fender Stratocaster 1954**: Classic electric guitar with physical body finish, maple neck, pickups, pickguard, and tremolo system.
- **Mechanical Keyboard**: Custom mechanical keyboard with individual keycaps, switches, rotary encoder knob, and chassis.

## 2. Part Focus & Camera Framing
Inspector category selections smoothly glide and frame the camera to specific components:
- **Case**: Isometric 3/4 chassis angle highlighting titanium bevels, antenna lines, and form factor.
- **Band**: Elevated loop profile framing strap texture and contrast stitching.
- **Crown**: Macro perspective focused on digital crown knurling and side buttons.
- **Display**: Straight-on view framing the sapphire crystal screen and bezel.
- **Back**: Reverse 180-degree rotation framing the ceramic backplate and optical heart rate sensor array.

## 3. Exploded View & 3D Part Labeling
- Models can be toggled into an exploded view where components translate smoothly along tuned spatial vectors.
- Billboarding HTML tags (`PartLabel`) float at anchor points in 3D space, showing component names and configuration details.

---

# State Management (`useConfiguratorStore`)

Global configurator state is managed via Zustand:

- `activeModel`: Currently loaded model (`"watch" | "keyboard" | "mtBike" | "guitar"`).
- `activeTab`: Selected inspector category tab (`"case" | "band" | "crown" | "face" | "back"`).
- `isExploded`: Boolean toggle indicating whether parts are exploded or assembled.
- `showLabels`: Boolean toggle controlling 3D HTML part label overlays.
- `cameraPosition`: `[x, y, z]` perspective camera position coordinates.
- `cameraTarget`: `[x, y, z]` look-at focus target vector for OrbitControls.
- `cameraFov`: Perspective camera field of view in degrees.
- `WATCH_CATEGORY_CAMERA`: Preset framing configurations mapping each category to `position`, `target`, and `fov`.

---

# Key Component Reference

- `PrimaryCanvas.tsx`: Core R3F canvas mounting lighting, reflector floor, environment maps, and camera rig.
- `CameraRig.tsx`: Perspective camera with smooth `useFrame` lerping for transitions between default, exploded, and part-focused views.
- `ConfiguratorSidebar.tsx`: Collapsible inspector sidebar featuring category tabs, tooltips, and customization controls.
- `WatchModel.tsx`: Component managing the Apple Watch Ultra 2 GLTF hierarchy, materials, and exploded transforms.
- `PartLabel.tsx`: Drei `Html`-based billboarding UI label pinned to 3D mesh coordinates.

---

# Canonical Routes

- `/`: Landing page with hero section, product selection cards, and feature highlights.
- `/configurator`: Interactive 3D studio with sidebar inspector and primary canvas.
- `/dashboard`: Personal product garage and saved configurations.
- `/garage`: Garage showcase.
- `/privacypolicy`: Privacy policy documentation.
- `/terms-of-service`: Terms and conditions.
- `/sitemap.xml`: Static sitemap generated for search engines and crawlers.
- `/llms.txt`: Curated markdown index for AI agents and LLMs.
- `/llms-full.txt`: Full concatenated markdown documentation.
